claim_one_line: LISTENING 6, THE WHOLE'S BOUND STATES OVER C (PROVED, exact; data-free): the moves' finite orbits from the finite subgroups of SU(2) sit at the frustration levels kappa = 2cos(2 pi k/n), n in {1,2,3,4,5,6,10}: Q8 gives the common point (-2) and 'nothing' (2), 2T adds 0, 2O adds +-1, and only the icosahedral bound states carry the golden levels +-phi and +-1/phi, so Q(sqrt 5) enters the whole as the level of its icosahedral bound states with no thread chosen
weave_or_thread: weave (every move acting together, every pair of every finite group, nothing chosen)
